in_marathi.name: Greshika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Grains, Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Greshika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Greshika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘grish’ which means ‘grain’ and ‘ikha’ which means ‘flowing’ or ‘moving’. The name is believed to represent the goddess of grains and wealth. In Hindu mythology, Greshika is also known as Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
